notes.title: Haunted Mines - Development Milestone
notes.notes: [p][/p][h2][b]Haunted Mines - Development Milestone[/b][/h2][p]I'm thrilled to finally say it, after over [b]2 years of solo development[/b], [i]Haunted Mines[/i] is [b]getting closer than ever to release[/b].[/p][p]What began as a simple idea has evolved into a deep, atmospheric horror experience powered by custom AI systems, online multiplayer, and dynamic match progression. And now, I'm ready to share more with you.[/p][h2][b]2 Years of Building[/b][/h2][p]This project started as a solo endeavor, born from a love for psychological horror and asymmetrical tension. Since then, the game has grown into something far bigger and more polished than I ever expected.[/p][p]Over the past two years, I've worked on:[/p][list][*][p]🔄 [b]Procedural map generation[/b] (so no run feels the same)[/p][/*][*][p]🧠 [b]Dual-Brain AI[/b] for the monster, designed to simulate both instinct and knowledge-based behavior[/p][/*][*][p]👥 [b]Online multiplayer[/b], using [b]Mirror[/b] and [b]Steamworks[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔊 [b]3D voice chat integration[/b] via [b]Vivox[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🎮 [b]Custom interaction systems[/b], task management, and match progression logic[/p][/*][*][p]🧰 Inventory, upgrades, economy systems, and match rewards[/p][/*][/list][p]It’s been a journey full of learning curves, especially integrating third-party tools like [b]Mirror[/b], [b]FizzySteamworks[/b], and [b]Vivox[/b], which all come with their own challenges. But the result is a unique multiplayer horror experience that I’m proud of.[/p][h2][b]Where We Are Now[/b][/h2][p]The game is now [b]feature-complete for an early access version[/b], meaning:[/p][list][*][p]All core gameplay systems are implemented[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer is kinda functional... You can play it, maybe not enjoy it, but at least try it out [url="https://emojipedia.org/es/cara-sonriendo-con-sudor-fr%C3%ADo"]😅[/url][/p][/*][*][p]The game loop is working from start to finish[/p][/*][*][p]It’s [b]stable and playable[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]What remains is [b]polish, optimization, bug hunting, and tuning, [/b]especially now that early testers are providing valuable feedback.[/p][h2][b]What Comes Next?[/b][/h2][p]Right now, I’m working on:[/p][list][*][p]✨ Visual polish: FX, lighting, UI feedback, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]🐞 Bug fixing and QoL improvements[/p][/*][*][p]📢 Marketing and wishlist growth (Steam & Itch)[/p][/*][*][p]📹 Reaching out to content creators and testers[/p][/*][*][p]🧱 Possibly adding more monster behavior depth, depending on feedback[/p][/*][/list][p]I’ve also started preparing pages on both [b]Steam and Itch.io[/b]. Your [b]wishlist, comment, or share really helps, [/b]it’s the best way to support a solo dev like me.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487740/Haunted_Mines/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]Thank You![/b][/h2][p]To everyone who’s followed the project, tested early builds, or just shown interest, thank you.[/p][p][i]Haunted Mines[/i] has been a passion project from the start, and I’m incredibly excited (and slightly nervous) to show it to the world. This devlog is just one step toward launch, and I can’t wait to bring you more updates soon.[/p][p]If you'd like to follow the development more closely, stay tuned here if you want to participate in future testing.[/p]
